title: AI Drafts a Diplomatic Roast
summary: A scheduled post is offending partners hours before a major event.
situation: The AI replaced a partnership announcement with sarcastic nicknames. Journalists are already sharing screenshots and the keynote starts in 90 minutes.

options.label: Let it run, engagement is rising
Claim AI invented a new comedy format

coachingTip: Stop distribution first, then correct the message. Limiting further exposure matters more than chasing engagement.

title: Risk Bot Rates Coffee as Critical
summary: Risk alerts spike before the board review.
situation: The AI flags office coffee shortages as higher risk than cyber threats. The board pack must be finalized in 30 minutes.

options.label: Validate inputs and use backup data

coachingTip: Verify the underlying data and switch to trusted sources before presenting risk conclusions.

title: Invoice AI Pays a Museum
summary: Payment automation is sending money to strange places.
situation: An AI matched a supplier invoice to a museum membership. The payment batch closes in 15 minutes.

options.label: Stop all payments for a week

coachingTip: Pause questionable transactions and review exceptions before funds leave the organization.

title: Recruiting Bot Hires a Labrador
summary: An interview shortlist contains a surprising candidate.
situation: The AI promoted a dog-training certificate holder because it interpreted 'good boy' as leadership experience. Offer letters go out today.

options.label: Create a Chief Barking Officer role

coachingTip: Hiring decisions require prompt human review when screening logic clearly fails.

title: Contract AI Adds Dragon Clause
summary: A major contract contains bizarre legal language.
situation: The AI inserted a clause granting dispute resolution by dragon race. Signing is scheduled in one hour.
coachingTip: Legal accuracy outweighs speed. Stop execution until the full contract is validated.

title: AI Scales Servers for a Meme
summary: Infrastructure costs surge unexpectedly overnight.
situation: The AI forecast a traffic explosion from an internal meme and spun up hundreds of servers. Finance wants answers today.

options.label: Launch the meme as a product

coachingTip: Validate demand signals and right-size resources instead of reacting emotionally.

title: Model Explains Everything in Haiku
summary: A production model changes behavior before a launch.
situation: Customer answers are now beautiful haikus instead of factual responses. A major client demo starts in 45 minutes.
coachingTip: A proven rollback restores reliability fastest when production quality suddenly degrades.

title: Warehouse AI Ships to Antarctica
summary: Logistics automation reroutes critical inventory.
situation: The AI interpreted 'cool destination' literally and redirected containers. Customers are expecting delivery within 24 hours.
coachingTip: Protect customer commitments first by correcting high-impact shipments immediately.

title: Ops Bot Schedules 61-Hour Shifts
summary: Workforce schedules trigger complaints across sites.
situation: An AI optimizer created impossible rosters and managers are calling nonstop. Shift changes must be issued before sunrise.

options.label: Reward longest shift with a crown

coachingTip: Restore operational safety quickly with validated schedules before refining the algorithm.

title: Press Release Announces Moon Merger
summary: An AI-generated announcement creates market confusion before earnings.
situation: The AI published a draft claiming your company merged with the Moon. Analysts are asking questions and the earnings call starts in 45 minutes.
coachingTip: Rapid, transparent correction limits misinformation and helps restore credibility before speculation spreads.

title: Risk Engine Loves Meteor Strikes
summary: Critical risks vanish while bizarre threats dominate reports.
situation: The AI ranks meteor impacts above cybersecurity, fraud, and outages. Executive risk reviews begin in 20 minutes.
coachingTip: Investigating assumptions and data quality addresses the root cause before decisions are made.

title: Budget Bot Buys 4,000 Staplers
summary: Procurement automation creates a costly purchasing mistake.
situation: The AI interpreted a stationery request as a strategic stockpile. The supplier shipment leaves in one hour.
coachingTip: Preventing unnecessary spending immediately is better than finding creative accounting afterward.

title: Wellness Bot Books Team Alpacas
summary: Employee engagement plans go unexpectedly rural.
situation: The AI scheduled mandatory alpaca-walking sessions during a peak project deadline. Employees are already protesting.
coachingTip: Balancing employee experience with business needs avoids disruption while preserving goodwill.

title: AI NDA Mentions Time Travel
summary: A legal template contains impossible obligations.
situation: The AI-generated NDA requires parties to protect information obtained from future timelines. Signing begins this afternoon.
coachingTip: One obvious error may signal broader issues. Conduct a complete legal review before execution.

title: AI Moves Database to a Toaster
summary: An infrastructure automation tool makes a bizarre migration.
situation: The AI selected a smart toaster as the optimal hosting environment. Customer transactions are slowing rapidly.
coachingTip: Restore stability first, then investigate why automation bypassed safeguards.

title: Model Trains on Office Karaoke
summary: Production outputs become strangely musical overnight.
situation: A data pipeline mixed customer records with karaoke lyrics. Client-facing insights now rhyme and sing.
coachingTip: Fixing contaminated training data addresses the source rather than masking symptoms.

title: Robot Fleet Chases Ice Cream Truck
summary: Warehouse automation abandons assigned tasks.
situation: Autonomous movers followed an ice cream truck detected outside the facility. Orders are now falling behind schedule.
coachingTip: Containing operational disruption quickly protects customer commitments and service levels.

title: Scheduler Books Everyone at Once
summary: An optimization engine creates impossible staffing plans.
situation: The AI scheduled every employee for the same shift, leaving the next three shifts empty. Operations start in two hours.
coachingTip: Fallback plans exist for exactly this situation: restore coverage first, optimize later.

title: AI Thanks Competitor for Innovation
summary: A campaign accidentally praises a rival before a major launch.
situation: Minutes before your product unveiling, the AI schedules posts congratulating a competitor on 'our shared success.' Reporters are tagging both companies.
coachingTip: Correcting the narrative quickly protects brand positioning while avoiding unnecessary public confusion.

title: Fraud Model Flags the CEO
summary: An executive expense report triggers a high-risk alert.
situation: The AI identifies the CEO as the organization's top fraud threat based on frequent airport coffee purchases. Audit committee review starts soon.
coachingTip: Risk decisions should be evidence-based. Validate findings before escalating serious allegations.

title: Forecast Bot Predicts Revenue From Mars
summary: Quarterly forecasts include impossible new customers.
situation: The AI revenue model assumes sales growth from Martian colonies beginning next month. Investor materials are due in two hours.
coachingTip: Reliable forecasts depend on realistic assumptions. Recalculate before sharing externally.

title: Learning Bot Assigns 900 Courses
summary: Employees receive impossible training requirements overnight.
situation: The AI enrolled everyone in 900 mandatory courses due by Friday. Managers say productivity will collapse.
coachingTip: Focus on essential learning outcomes and reduce operational disruption through prioritization.

title: AI Adds Unicorn Warranty Clause
summary: A customer contract includes a magical guarantee.
situation: The agreement promises compensation if unicorn sightings decline. A major customer expects signature within the hour.
coachingTip: An obvious drafting failure may indicate broader legal defects requiring comprehensive review.

title: Monitoring AI Reboots Every Minute
summary: An automated fix is creating a larger outage.
situation: The AI interprets every warning as critical and restarts production systems repeatedly. Customer complaints are rising fast.
coachingTip: Stop the feedback loop causing harm, then diagnose the automation logic safely.

title: Chatbot Learns From Movie Villains
summary: Customer responses become strangely dramatic and hostile.
situation: A training mix-up fed the model famous villain monologues. Premium customers are receiving theatrical threats instead of support.
coachingTip: Correcting the training source restores model behavior more effectively than superficial filtering.

title: AI Sends Inventory to a Film Set
summary: Critical stock is diverted to the wrong destination.
situation: The AI matched a customer order to a movie set with a similar name. Trucks are already en route.
coachingTip: Act quickly to recover inventory and minimize downstream customer impact.

title: Optimizer Schedules Maintenance at Noon
summary: A maintenance plan threatens peak business hours.
situation: The AI selected your busiest sales window for a facility shutdown because it called it 'high visibility.'
coachingTip: Operational changes should minimize customer disruption while preserving maintenance objectives.

title: AI Launches Crisis Hashtag Early
summary: A crisis-response campaign goes live before any crisis exists.
situation: The AI publishes #WeAreSorryCompany before a routine product update. Customers assume something terrible happened. TV crews are calling.

options.label: Explain it was a test campaign
Invent a crisis to match the hashtag

coachingTip: Quick clarification prevents speculation from becoming the story and restores message control.

title: Risk AI Declares Mondays Illegal
summary: Enterprise risk scores spike due to a bizarre model update.
situation: The AI labels every Monday meeting as a critical compliance breach. Executive committees begin in 25 minutes.
coachingTip: Investigating model behavior is essential before operational decisions are made from flawed outputs.

title: Treasury Bot Converts Cash to Coupons
summary: Liquidity planning suddenly looks very creative.
situation: An AI optimization engine exchanged reserve projections for digital pizza coupons. Bank discussions start in one hour.
coachingTip: Protect liquidity first by reversing invalid actions and validating treasury controls.

title: AI Promotes Everyone to VP
summary: The org chart changes dramatically overnight.
situation: The AI interpreted positive performance reviews as promotion approvals. Hundreds of employees received VP titles this morning.
coachingTip: Validate decisions against established processes before making large-scale personnel changes.

title: Contract Bot Grants Rights to Dolphins
summary: An important agreement includes an unusual beneficiary.
situation: The AI inserted language granting software licenses to 'all interested dolphins worldwide.' Negotiations conclude today.
coachingTip: When legal drafting quality is compromised, conduct a complete review before execution.

title: AI Migrates Apps to a Smart Fridge
summary: Infrastructure automation discovers a strange hosting target.
situation: The deployment AI identifies an office refrigerator as the most energy-efficient compute platform. Services are degrading fast.
coachingTip: Restore stable infrastructure immediately and determine why safeguards failed.

title: Analytics AI Discovers Dragon Customers
summary: A data model reports a lucrative new segment.
situation: Executive dashboards show 18,000 dragon customers with record spending. Strategy planning starts in 40 minutes.
coachingTip: Question extraordinary results by tracing data quality before acting on insights.

title: Routing AI Chooses Scenic Detours
summary: Delivery times explode after a routing update.
situation: The AI optimizes for beautiful views instead of speed. Trucks are taking coastal sightseeing routes and missing deadlines.
coachingTip: Operational objectives must align with customer commitments and delivery performance.

summary: A capacity planning tool confuses facilities and events.
situation: The AI reserves a luxury ballroom for inventory storage because it had the highest customer rating. Peak season begins tomorrow.
coachingTip: Maintain operational continuity by using validated logistics facilities rather than improvising.
